documents.title: Audited financial statements
documents.text:
Audited financial statements — Meridian Vale Partners (fictional).
In this document "MVPH" means Meridian Vale Partners. Meridian Vale Partners reports available liquidity of $31m for FY2024 on a reported basis. Meridian Vale Partners reports interest cover of 3x for FY2024. Meridian Vale Partners reports capex of $44.1m for LTM to 30 Jun 2025 on a reported basis. Meridian AB reports revenue of $459.7m for FY2025 on a reported basis. For Meridian Vale Partners, the permitted acquisitions basket is read as: capped at the greater of $15m and 20% of EBITDA. The fiscal year of Meridian Vale Partners ends on 30 June.

documents.title: Lender presentation
documents.text:
Lender presentation — Meridian Vale Partners (fictional).
Meridian Vale Partners reports available liquidity of $23.6m for FY2024 on a reported basis. Meridian Vale Partners reports interest cover of 3.3x for FY2024. Meridian Vale Partners reports cash margin of 4.7% for FY2024. Meridian Vale Partners reports customer concentration of 21.4% for FY2025. For Meridian Vale Partners, the permitted acquisitions basket is read as: uncapped where pro forma leverage stays below 4.0x.
